english.title: Dog not under proper control - complaint only
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the owner of a dog which was dangerous and was not kept under proper control, complaint is laid by **(..SPECIFY NAME..) who applies for an order that the dog is to be kept under proper control or destroyed
english.legislation: Pursuant to section 2 of the Dogs Act 1871.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Any proceedings must be instituted by a complaint.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Ci heb fod dan reolaeth dynn - cwyn yn unig
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) a chithau'n berchennog ci a oedd yn beryglus a heb ei gadw dan reolaeth dynn, cyflwynir cwyn gan **(..SPECIFY NAME..) sy'n gwneud cais am orchymyn i gadw'r ci dan reolaeth dynn neu i gael ei ddinistrio
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn unol ag adran 2 Deddf Cwn 1871.

other.powersofarrest: This is a complaint and NOT an offence. No power of arrest exists. However, consider the various alternative offence wordings listed above to which a power of arrest may be attached.
other.penalty:
Section 1 of the Dangerous Dogs Act 1989, provides that the court may direct that the dog is either kept under proper control by the owner or destroyed. The owner may also be disqualified from having custody of a dog.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
